name: @sos-2/companion
description: SOS 2.0 Local Companion Host (Work Order P11): the plain Node + TypeScript host of the authenticated local companion — the composition root assembling the durable P2 stores, the P5 Body Broker + Execution Fabric, the LocalCompanion contract (pairing authority, credential store, granted-scope private file port, simulated local process seam, durable local event log) and the §9 companion body (placement user-device), with the optional tier-4 browser/IDE bridges attached behind their honest simulated reference transports. The host runs on an INJECTED tick/command source (poll-driven, testable offline — no ambient timers; the apps/api + apps/worker-runtimes precedent). The §7 user-device model is enforced at the scheduling gate: local-only work orders QUEUE while the device reports offline and run when it reconnects (reconciliation FIRST — the durable local event log replays into the P2 live-store exactly-once, gap-free); cloud work orders never consult device presence (the task continues while the user's computer is off — cloud tasks never require the companion). The only impure boundary is the composition root (system clock injection). NO real desktop app ships in this Work Order: the honest installation status is NOT_YET_INSTALLED (reference runtime only; evidence never fabricated).
